format.use: Instagram Reel for the luxury barbershop TIM DESIGN

brand.name: TIM DESIGN
brand.palette_note: exact brand colors saved in Canva: black #111111 for backgrounds and the color grade, gold #C9A24B for the TIM DESIGN lettering, the logo and the ABONNEZ-VOUS text, cream #F3EEE3 for secondary text
brand.typography: elegant serif capitals with wide letter spacing, brushed gold

global_style.color_palette: strictly the TIM DESIGN brand palette: matte black #111111, brushed gold #C9A24B and warm cream #F3EEE3
global_style.lighting: moody low-key lighting, warm golden highlights from brass pendant lamps, deep blacks
global_style.grade: slightly desaturated cinematic grade, warm tones
global_style.lens: 35mm anamorphic look, subject razor sharp with crisp fine detail, soft creamy bokeh background
global_style.location: upscale modern barbershop, completely empty, nobody inside, matte black walls, cream marble floor, dark walnut counters
global_style.content_rule: only the salon, the tools and the products, never any person
global_style.editing_rhythm: fast-paced cuts synced to a beat, alternating close-up and wide shots, inspired by premium barbershop social media reels

shots.subject: extreme macro of a matte black pomade jar with a brushed gold lid engraved 'TIM DESIGN' on a dark wooden shelf
shots.camera: fast rack focus from blurred foreground to the jar
shots.motion: golden light glinting on the engraved lid

shots.subject: vintage barber pole with black and gold spiral stripes and a glowing cream-white globe on a dark wall
shots.camera: low angle close-up, quick upward tilt

shots.subject: macro of a professional gold metal hair clipper resting on black leather
shots.camera: fast lateral slide along the blade
shots.motion: sharp highlights moving across the gold teeth

shots.subject: ceiling of the salon with brass pendant lamps glowing warm
shots.motion: lamps glowing with a subtle flicker

shots.subject: gold straight razor opening slowly on a folded cream towel
shots.motion: blade catching a flash of golden light
shots.transition_out: cut to pure black for 0.2s on the beat drop

shots.subject: wide establishing shot of the whole empty salon: two black leather barber chairs with gold details, round gold-framed mirrors, brass pendant lamps, cream marble floor
shots.camera: slow smooth dolly-in at chest height
shots.motion: dust particles drifting in the light beams
shots.transition_out: fast zoom-in transition (wide to close) toward the nearest chair, with motion blur on the beat

shots.subject: close-up of a black leather barber chair headrest and gold armrest
shots.motion: warm reflections gliding on the leather

shots.subject: top-down view of a barber station: straight razor, black combs, gold scissors, shaving brush, cream towel neatly arranged on dark walnut
shots.motion: warm light reflections moving on the metal
shots.transition_out: fast pull-back transition (close to wide) on the beat

shots.subject: wide view of the full row of barber stations and mirrors, empty salon
shots.camera: fast crane-up revealing the whole room

shots.subject: floating dark wood shelves with rows of matte black and amber glass grooming products with gold caps, every label printed 'TIM DESIGN' in brushed gold serif capitals
shots.motion: light glinting on the gold caps and lettering
shots.transition_out: fast zoom-in transition (medium to close) on one bottle

shots.subject: macro of a matte black bottle, the gold 'TIM DESIGN' lettering sharp and centered
shots.motion: a line of golden light sweeping across the lettering

shots.subject: matte black smartphone rising up by itself from behind a dark walnut counter into frame, standing upright, screen showing the TIM DESIGN Instagram profile page
shots.camera: low angle, slow push-in toward the screen
shots.motion: phone sliding up smoothly, screen lighting up, salon softly blurred behind
shots.editing_note: generate the phone with a plain green or black screen, then insert a real screenshot of the TIM DESIGN Instagram page in editing (AI cannot reproduce the page reliably)
shots.transition_out: push through the phone screen: the screen fills the whole frame

shots.subject: the TIM DESIGN Instagram profile filling the frame
shots.motion: gold text 'ABONNEZ-VOUS' appearing over the screen with a light shimmer
shots.editing_note: add the ABONNEZ-VOUS text in editing (Canva / CapCut) in gold #C9A24B, serif capitals
shots.transition_out: gold flash, then fade to darker image

shots.subject: dark close-up of a gold hair clipper on black leather, very low-key lighting
shots.motion: faint golden glint along the blade
shots.editing_note: keep the image dark and calm with empty space in the center; overlay the TIM DESIGN logo and 'ABONNEZ-VOUS' in gold #C9A24B, with any secondary text (handle, address) in cream #F3EEE3

negative_prompt: people, person, clients, barbers, hands, fingers, arms, faces, body parts, silhouettes, reflections of people in mirrors, any text other than 'TIM DESIGN', misspelled lettering, garbled letters, other brand names or logos, watermark, subtitles, cartoon, illustration, CGI look, plastic textures, oversaturated colors, colors outside the black/gold/cream brand palette (blue, green, red, pink, cold chrome silver), neon lights, daylight, windows with outdoor views, harsh flat lighting, overexposed or blown-out highlights, blurry or out-of-focus subject, warped or melting objects, deformed tools, extra blades, duplicated objects, clutter, mess, hair on the floor, dirt, flicker artifacts, jitter, shaky handheld camera, fisheye distortion, dutch angle, low resolution, noise, compression artifacts
